_ported: Views whose port is finished. A view is compared against the frozen prototype only once its name is listed here, so switching the gate on is a deliberate line in a commit rather than a side effect of a route existing.

exempt.why: The phone item is not a port of the prototype. Below 760px it renders the six-slide deck designed in docs/mobile-item.html (DIA-360), which the prototype has no counterpart for, so a prototype baseline at 390px can only ever fail. Its own gate needs the spec's twelve embedded screens as the baseline source - filed separately. The desktop width of this view stays gated.

_exempt: view x project pairs that have deliberately left the prototype. Never add one to silence a diff: an exemption says the design diverged on purpose, and each carries the reason it did.
